mainEntity.name: What factors should I consider when choosing a contractor for my Airbnb-ready ADU?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a contractor for your Airbnb-ready ADU, consider their experience with ADU projects, familiarity with local East Bay building codes and short-term rental regulations, and their ability to manage the entire design-build process. Reviewing their portfolio for similar projects and checking references is crucial. We encourage clients to provide their specific vision, budget, and any preferred design elements early on, as this helps us tailor our proposal and demonstrate how our expertise aligns with their goals for an income-generating unit.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor experienced with ADUs, familiar with local East Bay codes for short-term rentals, and capable of managing the full design-build process for your project.
